package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	plannerpostgres "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root alone runs this actual repository proof after creating a coherent job
// through the registered Student snapshot boundary. No evidence/mastery/path/job
// is seeded here; the temporary error trigger is explicitly a DB failure fixture.
func TestT203HybridConsequencePostgresLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL not configured")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("exact isolated T20 planner database required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	store := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	work, found, err := store.ClaimHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: root must prepare a fresh actual owner snapshot job before this repository proof")
	}
	policy, err := store.GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if policy.MasterySkipConfidence != domain.DefaultMasteryConfidence {
		t.Fatalf("existing confidence threshold unexpectedly%v", policy.MasterySkipConfidence)
	}
	graph := domain.HybridPrerequisiteGraph{GoalCode: work.Job.Snapshot.Path.GoalCode, Targets: []domain.HybridPrerequisiteTarget{}}
	ownerGraph, err := store.GetPublishedGoalGraph(ctx, graph.GoalCode)
	if err == nil {
		graph.Available = true
		graph.GoalVersion = ownerGraph.Goal.Version
		graph.GraphVersion = ownerGraph.Goal.GraphVersion
		for _, target := range ownerGraph.Targets {
			row := domain.HybridPrerequisiteTarget{Ref: domain.HybridTargetRef{Type: target.Ref.Type, Key: target.Ref.Key, Version: target.Ref.Version}, Prerequisites: []domain.HybridTargetRef{}}
			for _, pre := range target.Prerequisites {
				row.Prerequisites = append(row.Prerequisites, domain.HybridTargetRef{Type: pre.Type, Key: pre.Key, Version: pre.Version})
			}
			graph.Targets = append(graph.Targets, row)
		}
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pinned, err := store.CheckpointHybridConsequenceInputs(ctx, work, policy, graph)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if pinned.Inputs == nil || pinned.Inputs.InputHash == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing durable policy pin")
	}
	firstHash := pinned.Inputs.InputHash
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, pinned, time.Unix(1, 0).UTC()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	restarted := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	again, found, err := restarted.ClaimHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || again.Job.ID != pinned.Job.ID || again.Inputs == nil || again.Inputs.InputHash != firstHash {
		t.Fatalf("restart lost pin:%#v %v", again, err)
	}
	// Named mutation fixture: a later observed policy cannot overwrite a first pin.
	changedPolicy := policy
	changedPolicy.MasterySkipConfidence = .99
	again, err = restarted.CheckpointHybridConsequenceInputs(ctx, again, changedPolicy, graph)
	if err != nil || again.Inputs.InputHash != firstHash || again.Inputs.Policy.MasterySkipConfidence != policy.MasterySkipConfidence {
		t.Fatal("policy activation drift changed pinned evaluator inputs")
	}
	consequence, err := domain.EvaluateHybridSnapshot(again.Job.Snapshot, *again.Inputs)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = store.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, pinned, consequence); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("retired claim token completed newer evaluation:%v", err)
	}
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, pinned, time.Now()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("retired claim token cleared newer evaluator lease:%v", err)
	}
	forged := consequence
	forged.ReasonCodes = []string{"CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT"}
	if consequence.ReasonCodes[0] == "CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT" {
		forged.ReasonCodes = []string{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE"}
	}
	if domain.ValidateHybridConsequence(forged) == nil {
		if _, err = restarted.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, again, forged); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
			t.Fatalf("non-evaluator result accepted:%v", err)
		}
	} else {
		t.Fatal("forged wire fixture must remain structurally valid")
	}
	// Force an actual PostgreSQL insert failure after claim and immutable input read.
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `CREATE FUNCTION t203_fail_receipt_fixture() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'T203_NAMED_DB_FAILURE_FIXTURE'; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER t203_fail_receipt_fixture BEFORE INSERT ON hybrid_consequence_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION t203_fail_receipt_fixture();`)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		_, _ = pool.Exec(context.Background(), `DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS t203_fail_receipt_fixture ON hybrid_consequence_receipt; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS t203_fail_receipt_fixture();`)
	}()
	if _, err = restarted.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, again, consequence); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "T203_NAMED_DB_FAILURE_FIXTURE") {
		t.Fatalf("forced insert failure missing:%v", err)
	}
	var receipts int
	var completed bool
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_consequence_receipt WHERE job_id=$1),completed FROM hybrid_consequence_work WHERE job_id=$1`, again.Job.ID).Scan(&receipts, &completed); err != nil || receipts != 0 || completed {
		t.Fatalf("partial consequence after rollback receipts%d completed%v:%v", receipts, completed, err)
	}
	if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `DROP TRIGGER t203_fail_receipt_fixture ON hybrid_consequence_receipt; DROP FUNCTION t203_fail_receipt_fixture();`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	receipt, err := restarted.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, again, consequence)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	replay, err := restarted.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, again, consequence)
	if err != nil || replay.PayloadHash != receipt.PayloadHash || !replay.CommittedAt.Equal(receipt.CommittedAt) {
		t.Fatalf("lost-ACK receipt replay:%v", err)
	}
	changed := consequence
	changed.ExpectedPathRevision++
	if _, err = restarted.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, again, changed); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("changed payload under same consequenceID:%v", err)
	}
	if err = restarted.ReleaseHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, again, time.Now()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatal("completed claim released")
	}
	for _, query := range []string{
		`UPDATE hybrid_consequence_input SET input_hash=input_hash WHERE job_id=$1`,
		`DELETE FROM hybrid_consequence_input WHERE job_id=$1`,
		`UPDATE hybrid_consequence_receipt SET payload_hash=payload_hash WHERE job_id=$1`,
		`DELETE FROM hybrid_consequence_receipt WHERE job_id=$1`,
	} {
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, query, again.Job.ID); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("immutable input/receipt mutated:%s", query)
		}
	}
	for _, query := range []string{`TRUNCATE hybrid_consequence_input`, `TRUNCATE hybrid_consequence_receipt`, `TRUNCATE hybrid_evaluation_job CASCADE`, `TRUNCATE hybrid_planning_state_inbox CASCADE`} {
		if _, err = pool.Exec(ctx, query); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("durable history truncated:%s", query)
		}
	}
	if stored, err := restarted.GetHybridConsequence(ctx, again.Job.ID); err != nil || stored.PayloadHash != receipt.PayloadHash {
		t.Fatal("negative guards failed to preserve receipt")
	}
	t.Logf("actual job=%s snapshot=%s policy_input_hash=%s consequence=%s outcome=%s durable replay and rollback preserved", again.Job.ID, again.Job.SnapshotRef, firstHash, receipt.Consequence.ConsequenceID, receipt.Consequence.Outcome)
}
